modules.name: eks
modules.title: EKS
modules.summary: Create an Amazon EKS cluster with managed node groups, core add-ons, access controls, EKS capabilities, and optional Karpenter readiness.

required_inputs.name: name
required_inputs.description: Name prefix for module-created resources. Used as the EKS cluster name when cluster_name is null.

required_inputs.name: subnet_ids
required_inputs.description: Subnet IDs for the EKS control plane and default node groups. Use at least two subnets in different Availability Zones.

modules.name: eks-auto
modules.title: EKS Auto Mode
modules.summary: Build an EKS Auto Mode cluster with managed compute, load balancing, block storage, Pod Identity, and rendered Kubernetes resources.

required_inputs.name: name
required_inputs.description: Name prefix for module-created resources. Used as the EKS cluster name when cluster_name is null.

required_inputs.name: subnet_ids
required_inputs.description: Subnet IDs for the EKS control plane and EKS Auto Mode managed compute. Use at least two subnets in different Availability Zones.

modules.name: eks-node-group
modules.title: EKS Managed Node Group
modules.summary: Provision an EKS managed node group with IAM, scaling controls, launch template options, labels, and Kubernetes taints.

required_inputs.name: cluster_name
required_inputs.description: The name of the EKS cluster.

required_inputs.name: subnet_ids
required_inputs.description: A list of subnet IDs to launch resources in.

modules.name: eks-fargate-profile
modules.title: EKS Fargate Profile
modules.summary: Configure an AWS Fargate profile for EKS workloads, including selectors, subnet placement, and the pod execution IAM role.

required_inputs.name: cluster_name
required_inputs.description: The name of the EKS cluster

required_inputs.name: fargate_profile_name
required_inputs.description: Name of the EKS Fargate Profile. If not provided, profile will be called `fargate-profile-namespace_name`.

required_inputs.name: labels
required_inputs.description: Key-value mapping of Kubernetes labels for selection

required_inputs.name: namespace
required_inputs.description: Kubernetes namespace for which fargate profile will be used.

required_inputs.name: subnet_ids
required_inputs.description: Identifiers of private EC2 Subnets to associate with the EKS Fargate Profile. These subnets must have the following resource tag: kubernetes.io/cluster/cluster_name.

modules.name: kms
modules.title: KMS
modules.summary: Configure an AWS KMS key with an optional alias, key policy, rotation controls, multi-Region support, and resource tags.

modules.name: vpc-flow-logs
modules.title: VPC Flow Logs
modules.summary: Enable AWS VPC Flow Logs and deliver network traffic records to a managed CloudWatch log group with the required IAM role.

required_inputs.name: name_prefix
required_inputs.description: A prefix used for naming resources.
